name: Capital City Bank Group, Inc.
summary: Capital City Bank Group, Inc. operates as the financial holding company for Capital City Bank, providing commercial and consumer banking services, including business and real estate lending, personal and vehicle loans, credit cards, deposit accounts, treasury management, and wealth and trust services. As of December 31, 2021, its network included 57 banking branches and 86 ATM/ITM locations across Florida, Georgia, and Alabama. Capital City Bank Group, Inc. was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Tallahassee, Florida.
